questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किस देश से ज्युसेपे गैरीबाल्डी का संबंध था ?
questions.text_english: From which of the following countries Giuseppe Garibaldi belonged to ?
questions.solution: Giuseppe Garibaldi belonged to Italy. He was a central figure in the Italian Risorgimento and played a crucial role in the unification of Italy through his military campaigns.
questions.solution_hindi: ज्युसेपे गैरीबाल्डी का संबंध इटली से था। वह इतालवी एकीकरण के एक प्रमुख व्यक्ति थे और उन्होंने अपने सैन्य अभियानों के माध्यम से इटली के एकीकरण में महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी।
questions.chapter: The Rise of Nationalism in Europe

questions.text:
नीचे दो कथन दिए गए हैं। ये अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) हैं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A) : 1871 के बाद यूरोप में राष्ट्रवादी तनाव का सबसे गंभीर स्रोत बाल्कन था।
कारण (R) : बाल्कन का एक बड़ा हिस्सा ऑटोमन साम्राज्य के नियंत्रण में था।
questions.text_english:
Two statements are given below. They are Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Read both the statements and choose the correct option.
Assertion (A): The most serious source of nationalist tension in Europe after 1871 was Balkan.
Reason (R) : A large part of the Balkan was under the control of Ottoman Empire.

options.A: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं और (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: (A) और (R) दोनों सही हैं लेकिन (R), (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।

options_english.A: Both, (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A).
options_english.B: Both, (A) and (R) are true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A).

questions.solution: Both the Assertion and Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. The spread of romantic nationalism combined with the disintegration of the Ottoman Empire made the Balkan region highly explosive and the primary source of nationalist tension.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं, और कारण अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है। रूमानी राष्ट्रवाद के प्रसार और ऑटोमन साम्राज्य के विघटन ने बाल्कन क्षेत्र को अत्यधिक विस्फोटक बना दिया, जिससे यह राष्ट्रवादी तनाव का मुख्य स्रोत बन गया।
questions.chapter: The Rise of Nationalism in Europe

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को कालक्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
I. कुस्तुनतुनिया की संधि
II. नेपोलियन की हार
III. इटली का एकीकरण
IV. जर्मनी का एकीकरण
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following events in chronological order and choose the correct option from the following:
I. Treaty of Constantinople
II. Defeat of Napoleon
III. Unification of Italy
IV. Unification of Germany
questions.solution: The correct chronological sequence begins with the Defeat of Napoleon in 1815 (II), followed by the Treaty of Constantinople in 1832 (I). The Unification of Germany was finalized in 1871 (IV), which occurred alongside the final stages of the Unification of Italy (III). Depending on specific textbook milestones, option C closely matches the general timeline.
questions.solution_hindi: सही कालानुक्रमिक क्रम 1815 में नेपोलियन की हार (II) से शुरू होता है, उसके बाद 1832 में कुस्तुनतुनिया की संधि (I) होती है। जर्मनी का एकीकरण 1871 (IV) में पूरा हुआ था, जिसे इटली के एकीकरण (III) के अंतिम चरणों के साथ देखा जाता है। दिए गए विकल्पों में सी सबसे उपयुक्त है।

questions.text:
भारतीय राष्ट्रवाद से संदर्भित निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा जोड़ा सुमेलित है?
(a) सरदार पटेल : हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन आर्मी
(b) भगत सिंह : स्वराज पार्टी
(c) सी.आर. दास : बारदोली सत्याग्रह
(d) जवाहर लाल नेहरू : अवध किसान सभा
questions.text_english:
Which one of the following pairs regarding Indian nationalism is correctly matched ?
(a) Sardar Patel : Hindustan Socialist Republican Army
(b) Bhagat Singh : Swaraj Party
(c) C.R. Das : Bardoli Satyagraha
(d) Jawahar Lal Nehru : Oudh Kisan Sabha

options.A: सरदार पटेल : हिंदुस्तान सोशलिस्ट रिपब्लिकन आर्मी
options.D: जवाहर लाल नेहरू : अवध किसान सभा

options_english.A: Sardar Patel : Hindustan Socialist Republican Army
options_english.D: Jawahar Lal Nehru : Oudh Kisan Sabha

questions.solution: Jawaharlal Nehru traveled through Awadh and set up the Oudh Kisan Sabha along with Baba Ramchandra. The other pairs are incorrect: Sardar Patel led the Bardoli Satyagraha, Bhagat Singh was associated with the HSRA, and C.R. Das formed the Swaraj Party.
questions.solution_hindi: जवाहरलाल नेहरू ने अवध का दौरा किया और बाबा रामचंद्र के साथ मिलकर अवध किसान सभा की स्थापना की। अन्य जोड़े गलत हैं: सरदार पटेल ने बारदोली सत्याग्रह का नेतृत्व किया, भगत सिंह एचएसआरए से जुड़े थे, और सी.आर. दास ने स्वराज पार्टी बनाई थी।

questions.text:
सही सुमेलित जोड़े का चयन कीजिए।
(a) लौह धातु : प्राकृतिक गैस
(b) अलौह धातु : निकल
(c) अधात्विक खनिज : बलुआ पत्थर
(d) ऊर्जा खनिज : कोबाल्ट
questions.text_english:
Choose the correctly matched pair.
(a) Ferrous : Natural Gas
(b) Non-Ferrous : Nickel
(c) Non-Metallic Minerals : Limestone
(d) Energy Minerals : Cobalt

options.C: अधात्विक खनिज : बलुआ पत्थर / चूना पत्थर

questions.solution: Limestone is correctly categorized as a non-metallic mineral because it does not contain metal elements. Natural gas is an energy mineral, nickel is a ferrous mineral, and cobalt is also a ferrous mineral, making the other pairs incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: चूना पत्थर (बलुआ पत्थर) को सही ढंग से एक अधात्विक खनिज के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है क्योंकि इसमें धातु के तत्त्व नहीं होते हैं। प्राकृतिक गैस एक ऊर्जा खनिज है, निकल एक लौह धातु है, और कोबाल्ट भी एक लौह धातु है, इसलिए अन्य जोड़े गलत हैं।

questions.text:
दिए गए कथनों को पढ़िए और निम्नलिखित में से रबी शस्य ऋतु के संबंध में सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
I. रबी फसलों को शीत ऋतु में बोया जाता है।
II. इन्हें अक्टूबर से दिसंबर में बोया जाता है और अप्रैल से जून में काटा जाता है।
III. इसकी मुख्य फसलें मक्का, कपास और जूट हैं।
IV. पंजाब, हरियाणा और उत्तर प्रदेश गेहूँ उत्पादन के महत्त्वपूर्ण राज्य हैं।
questions.text_english:
Read the given statements and choose the correct option with regard to Rabi cropping season from the following:
I. Rabi crops are sown in winter.
II. Sown from October to December and harvested from April to June.
III. Important crops are Maize, Cotton, Jute.
IV. Punjab, Haryana, Uttar Pradesh are important for the production of wheat.
questions.solution: Statements I, II, and IV are correct descriptions of the Rabi cropping season. Statement III is incorrect because Maize, Cotton, and Jute are Kharif crops, not Rabi crops. Therefore, option C is the correct answer.
questions.solution_hindi: कथन I, II और IV रबी फसल के मौसम का सही वर्णन करते हैं। कथन III गलत है क्योंकि मक्का, कपास और जूट खरीफ फसलें हैं, न कि रबी फसलें। इसलिए, विकल्प C सही उत्तर है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित जानकारी की सहायता से मृदा की पहचान कीजिए।
• यह उच्च तापमान वाले क्षेत्रों में विकसित होती है।
• यह भारी वर्षा से अत्यधिक विक्षालन का परिणाम है।
• इसमें ह्यूमस की मात्रा कम पाई जाती है।
questions.text_english:
Identify the soil with the help of following information.
• It develops in areas with high temperature.
• It is the result of intense leaching due to heavy rain.
• Humus content is low.
questions.solution: Laterite soil develops in areas experiencing high temperature and heavy rainfall. The intense rainfall leads to severe leaching of nutrients, and the high temperature destroys most of the microorganisms, resulting in low humus content.
questions.solution_hindi: लैटेराइट मृदा उच्च तापमान और भारी वर्षा वाले क्षेत्रों में विकसित होती है। तीव्र वर्षा से पोषक तत्त्वों का भारी विक्षालन होता है, और उच्च तापमान अधिकांश सूक्ष्मजीवों को नष्ट कर देता है, जिसके परिणामस्वरूप ह्यूमस की मात्रा कम हो जाती है।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द महिलाओं की सामाजिक, राजनीतिक और आर्थिक समानता में विश्वास और उसकी वकालत करने से संबंधित है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following term refers to the belief in and advocacy for the social, political and economic equality of women?
questions.solution: Feminism is the ideology and movement that strongly believes in and advocates for equal rights and opportunities for men and women across social, political, and economic spheres.
questions.solution_hindi: नारीवाद (Feminism) वह विचारधारा और आंदोलन है जो सामाजिक, राजनीतिक और आर्थिक क्षेत्रों में पुरुषों और महिलाओं के लिए समान अधिकारों और अवसरों में दृढ़ता से विश्वास करता है और उसकी वकालत करता है।

questions.text:
दिए गए कथनों को पढ़िए :
• भारत का कोई भी राजकीय धर्म नहीं है।
• भारत में सभी समुदायों को किसी भी धर्म का पालन करने और प्रचार करने की आजादी है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों के लिए निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संवैधानिक शब्द उपयोग किया गया है ?
questions.text_english:
Read the given statements:
• India has no official religion.
• All the communities have freedom to profess and practice any religion in India.
Which one of the following constitutional term is used for the above statements ?
questions.solution: The term 'Secular' means that the state does not have an official religion and that all individuals and communities possess the freedom to profess, practice, and propagate any religion without discrimination.
questions.solution_hindi: 'पंथनिरपेक्ष' (Secular) शब्द का अर्थ है कि राज्य का कोई आधिकारिक धर्म नहीं है और सभी व्यक्तियों और समुदायों को बिना किसी भेदभाव के किसी भी धर्म को मानने, आचरण करने और प्रचार करने की स्वतंत्रता है।

questions.text:
स्तंभ 1 का मिलान स्तंभ II से कीजिए और सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
I. केन्द्रीय सूची के विषय -> A. इन विषयों पर सिर्फ राज्य सरकारें कानून बनाती हैं
II. राज्य सूची के विषय -> B. एकरूपता के लिए केन्द्र सरकार इन पर कानून बनाती है।
III. समवर्ती सूची के विषय -> C. केन्द्र और राज्य सरकारों के अधिकार क्षेत्र के तहत विषय।
IV. बाकी बचे विषय -> D. नए विषयों पर केन्द्र सरकार कानून बनाती है।
questions.text_english:
Match the Column I with Column II and choose the correct option:
I. Union list subjects -> A. State Governments alone make laws on it.
II. State list subjects -> B. For uniformity Central Government Legislates on it.
III. Concurrent subjects -> C. Subjects under Jurisdiction of Centre and State Governments.
IV. Residuary subjects -> D. Central Government legislates on new subjects.
questions.solution: Union list subjects require national uniformity, hence only the Central Government legislates on them (I-B). State Governments exclusively make laws for State list subjects (II-A). Both legislate on Concurrent subjects (III-C). The Central Government has jurisdiction over new, Residuary subjects (IV-D).
questions.solution_hindi: केन्द्रीय सूची के विषयों में राष्ट्रीय एकरूपता की आवश्यकता होती है, इसलिए केवल केन्द्र सरकार उन पर कानून बनाती है (I-B)। राज्य सरकारें विशेष रूप से राज्य सूची के विषयों के लिए कानून बनाती हैं (II-A)। दोनों समवर्ती विषयों (III-C) पर कानून बनाते हैं। नए, बाकी बचे विषयों (IV-D) पर केन्द्र सरकार का अधिकार है।
questions.topic: What makes India a federal country?

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ब्रुसेल्स में अलग सरकार बनाने में बेल्ज़ियम का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य था ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following was the primary objective of Belgium to form the separate government in Brussels ?
questions.solution: The primary objective of forming a separate government in Brussels was to ensure linguistic accommodation. It established equal representation for both the French-speaking and Dutch-speaking communities to prevent ethnic conflicts and maintain harmony.
questions.solution_hindi: ब्रुसेल्स में एक अलग सरकार बनाने का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य भाषायी समायोजन सुनिश्चित करना था। इसने जातीय संघर्षों को रोकने और सद्भाव बनाए रखने के लिए फ्रेंच भाषी और डच भाषी दोनों समुदायों के लिए समान प्रतिनिधित्व स्थापित किया।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किस देश में दो-दलीय प्रणाली है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following countries has two-party system?
questions.solution: The United Kingdom (along with the USA) operates predominantly under a two-party system, where power usually alternates between two main political parties (Conservative and Labour). China has a one-party system, while India and Pakistan have multi-party systems.
questions.solution_hindi: यूनाइटेड किंगडम (संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के साथ) मुख्य रूप से दो-दलीय प्रणाली के तहत काम करता है, जहाँ सत्ता आमतौर पर दो मुख्य राजनीतिक दलों (कंजर्वेटिव और लेबर) के बीच बदलती रहती है। चीन में एक-दलीय प्रणाली है, जबकि भारत और पाकिस्तान में बहु-दलीय प्रणाली है।
questions.topic: How many parties should we have?

questions.text: लोकतांत्रिक देश में 'नियंत्रण और संतुलन' की क्या भूमिका है ? निम्नलिखित में से सबसे उपयुक्त विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: What role do 'checks and balances' play in a democratic country? Choose the most suitable option from the following.

options.A: प्रतिनिधियों के बिना सरकार का प्रत्यक्ष रूप स्थापित करना।
options.B: अधिनायकवाद को रोकने के लिए शक्तियों का पृथक्करण करना।
options.C: संविधान में किसी भी बदलाव को रोकना।
options.D: सरकार की एक शाखा के लिए पूर्ण शक्ति सुनिश्चित करना।

options_english.A: To establish a direct form of government without representatives.
options_english.B: To create a separation of powers to prevent from authoritarianism.
options_english.C: To prevent any change to the Constitution.
options_english.D: To ensure absolute power for one branch of government.

questions.solution: Checks and balances exist to separate and distribute powers across different organs of government (legislature, executive, judiciary). This ensures that no single branch acquires unlimited power, thereby preventing authoritarianism and safeguarding democracy.
questions.solution_hindi: सरकार के विभिन्न अंगों (विधायिका, कार्यपालिका, न्यायपालिका) के बीच शक्तियों को अलग करने और वितरित करने के लिए नियंत्रण और संतुलन की व्यवस्था होती है। यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि किसी एक शाखा को असीमित शक्ति प्राप्त न हो, जिससे अधिनायकवाद को रोका जा सके और लोकतंत्र की रक्षा की जा सके।

questions.text:
मान लीजिए एक परिवार के सदस्यों की मासिक आय क्रमशः निम्नलिखित है :
• माता - रु. 50,000/-
• पिता - रु. 40,000/-
• पुत्र - रु. 20,000/-
• पुत्री - रु. 20,000/-
इस परिवार की औसत मासिक आय होगी :
questions.text_english:
Suppose, the monthly income of the family members is as follows respectively:
• Mother - Rs. 50,000/-
• Father - Rs. 40,000/-
• Son - Rs. 20,000/-
• Daughter - Rs. 20,000/-
The average income of the family would be :
questions.solution: Average income is calculated by dividing the total income by the number of members. Total income = 50,000 + 40,000 + 20,000 + 20,000 = 1,30,000. Dividing this by 4 family members gives Rs. 32,500.

questions.text_english: Why do lenders often require collateral before lending loan? Choose the most suitable option from the following.

options.C: अपने लाभ को बढ़ाने के लिए।
options.D: ऋण चूक के जोखिम को कम करने के लिए।

options_english.A: To lower interest rates for borrowers.
options_english.D: To mitigate the risk of loan default.

questions.solution: Collateral is an asset that the borrower owns and uses as a guarantee to a lender until the loan is repaid. Lenders require it primarily to mitigate the risk of default; if the borrower fails to repay, the lender can sell the collateral to recover the money.
questions.solution_hindi: समर्थक ऋणाधार (Collateral) वह संपत्ति है जिसका मालिक उधारकर्ता होता है और जिसका उपयोग वह ऋणदाता को गारंटी के रूप में करता है जब तक कि ऋण चुकाया नहीं जाता। ऋणदाता मुख्य रूप से ऋण चूक के जोखिम को कम करने के लिए इसकी मांग करते हैं; यदि उधारकर्ता ऋण नहीं चुकाता है, तो ऋणदाता अपने पैसे वसूलने के लिए संपत्ति बेच सकता है।

questions.text_english: The Silk route was a good example of vibrant pre-modern trade and cultural links between distant parts of the world. Explain the statement with any two examples.

key_points: Chinese pottery, textiles, and spices traveled through this route to Europe.
Precious metals like gold and silver flowed from Europe to Asia in return.
It also facilitated cultural and religious exchange, such as the spread of Buddhism, Christianity, and Islam.

questions.solution: The Silk Route facilitated vibrant pre-modern trade and cultural links. For instance, Chinese pottery, Indian textiles, and spices were actively exported to Europe along these routes. In exchange, precious metals like gold and silver flowed from Europe to Asia. Culturally, early Christian missionaries, Muslim preachers, and Buddhist monks utilized these paths to spread their religions across continents.
questions.solution_hindi: सिल्क मार्ग ने आधुनिक काल से पहले के युग में दुनिया के दूर स्थित भागों के बीच जीवंत व्यापारिक और सांस्कृतिक संपर्कों को सुगम बनाया। उदाहरण के लिए, चीनी मिट्टी के बर्तन, भारतीय वस्त्र और मसाले इन मार्गों के माध्यम से यूरोप भेजे जाते थे। बदले में, यूरोप से एशिया में सोना और चांदी जैसी कीमती धातुएं आती थीं। सांस्कृतिक रूप से, शुरुआती ईसाई मिशनरियों, मुस्लिम उपदेशकों और बौद्ध भिक्षुओं ने महाद्वीपों में अपने धर्मों का प्रसार करने के लिए इन मार्गों का उपयोग किया।

Moral reason: It is the very spirit of democracy.

questions.solution: Power sharing is highly desirable for two main reasons. Prudentially, it helps reduce the possibility of conflict and violence between different social groups, ensuring political stability. Morally, power sharing is the very spirit of democracy, giving citizens a stake in the system through active participation.
questions.solution_hindi: सत्ता की साझेदारी दो मुख्य कारणों से जरूरी है। युक्तिपरक (Prudential) कारण: यह विभिन्न सामाजिक समूहों के बीच टकराव और हिंसा की संभावना को कम करती है, जिससे राजनीतिक स्थिरता सुनिश्चित होती है। नैतिक कारण: सत्ता की साझेदारी लोकतंत्र की आत्मा है; यह सक्रिय भागीदारी के माध्यम से नागरिकों को शासन प्रणाली का हिस्सा बनाती है।

Private Sector is owned by individuals/companies, focuses on profit-making.

questions.solution: The public sector is owned and managed by the government, with the primary objective of providing public welfare and essential services (e.g., Railways). sub_questions.text_english: Describe any three causes that led to the Non-Cooperation Movement.

key_points: The brutal Jallianwala Bagh massacre created widespread anger.
The oppressive Rowlatt Act denied basic civil rights.
The Khilafat issue united Hindus and Muslims against the British.

sub_questions.solution: The Non-Cooperation Movement was triggered by three primary causes. First, the unjust Rowlatt Act angered Indians by allowing political prisoners to be detained without trial. Second, the horrific Jallianwala Bagh massacre intensified anti-British sentiments nationwide. Finally, the Khilafat issue provided an opportunity to unite Hindus and Muslims under a unified national movement.

key_points: The arrival of the Simon Commission without any Indian members.
The demand for 'Purna Swaraj' at the Lahore Session in 1929.
Lord Irwin's vague offer of 'dominion status' and the oppressive Salt Tax.

sub_questions.solution: The Civil Disobedience Movement was initiated due to several key factors. First, the Simon Commission was universally boycotted in India because it lacked Indian representation. Second, the formal demand for 'Purna Swaraj' (complete independence) was adopted at the 1929 Lahore Congress. Third, Gandhi's eleven demands, particularly the abolition of the oppressive salt tax, were rejected by Viceroy Irwin.

questions.text_english: 'Manufacturing industries are considered the backbone of economic development. Justify the statement.

key_points: Helps in modernising agriculture.
Provides jobs in secondary and tertiary sectors, reducing agricultural dependence.
Export of manufactured goods expands trade and brings in foreign exchange.

questions.solution: Manufacturing industries act as the backbone of economic development because they play a crucial role in modernising agriculture, which is the base of our economy. They significantly reduce the heavy dependence of people on agricultural income by providing massive employment in the secondary and tertiary sectors. Moreover, exporting manufactured goods expands trade and commerce, bringing in much-needed foreign exchange and aiding overall prosperity.

key_points: Credit helps businesses meet ongoing expenses and complete production on time.
It allows farmers to purchase seeds, fertilizers, and equipment before the harvest.

questions.solution: Credit is absolutely essential for economic activities as it provides the necessary capital for businesses and individuals. For example, a manufacturer can use credit to purchase raw materials and pay workers in advance to complete a large order on time, thereby increasing their profit. Similarly, farmers rely on crop loans at the beginning of the season to buy seeds and fertilizers, repaying it after a successful harvest. Thus, affordable credit accelerates economic growth.

questions.text_english: How is the issue of sustainability important for development ? Explain.

key_points: Ensures resources are not exhausted for future generations.
Prevents environmental degradation during economic growth.
Promotes the judicious use of non-renewable resources like groundwater and fossil fuels.

questions.solution: The issue of sustainability is vital because true development must meet the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs. Unregulated economic growth often leads to severe environmental degradation and the rapid depletion of non-renewable resources like groundwater and fossil fuels. Sustainable development ensures a balanced approach, promoting judicious resource management so that long-term economic and human well-being is securely maintained.

sub_questions.text_english: How did the ideology of 'liberalism' affect the Europe in early nineteenth century? Explain.

key_points: Political sphere: Supported freedom of the individual and equality before the law.
Advocated the end of autocracy and clerical privileges.
Supported the creation of a constitution and representative government.
Economic sphere: Demanded freedom of markets and abolition of state-imposed restrictions.
Formation of Zollverein (customs union) unified economic territories.

sub_questions.solution: In early nineteenth-century Europe, the ideology of liberalism profoundly affected both political and economic spheres. Politically, liberalism stood for the freedom of the individual and equality of all before the law. It heavily advocated for the end of autocracy, the abolition of absolute monarchies, and the dismantling of clerical privileges. Liberals demanded a constitution and a representative government established through Parliament. They also stressed the inviolability of private property. Economically, liberalism meant the freedom of markets and the outright abolition of state-imposed restrictions on the movement of goods and capital. This economic philosophy led to the creation of 'Zollverein', a customs union that eliminated tariff barriers and created a unified economic territory, thus deeply stimulating nationalist sentiments across the continent.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the process of formation of 'United Kingdom of Great Britain'.

key_points: Unlike other nations, the UK was formed through a long, drawn-out process, not sudden revolution.
The English Parliament seized power from the monarchy in 1688.
The Act of Union (1707) united England and Scotland.
Scotland's distinctive culture was suppressed by English dominance.
Ireland was forcibly incorporated in 1801 after a failed Catholic revolt.

sub_questions.solution: The formation of the 'United Kingdom of Great Britain' was not the result of a sudden upheaval or revolution, but rather a long, drawn-out parliamentary process. Initially, the British Isles were inhabited by distinct ethnic groups: English, Welsh, Scot, and Irish. In 1688, the English Parliament successfully seized power from the monarchy, establishing itself as the core instrument of nation-building. The defining moment was the Act of Union in 1707 between England and Scotland, which officially created the 'United Kingdom of Great Britain'. Following this, English dominance systematically suppressed Scotland's distinctive culture and political institutions. Similarly, Ireland faced religious divisions between Catholics and Protestants. The English strongly supported the Protestants, helping them establish dominance. After a failed Catholic revolt led by Wolfe Tone, Ireland was forcibly incorporated into the UK in 1801, cementing a unified British nation.

sub_questions.text_english: How is energy a basic requirement for economic development ? Explain.

key_points: Energy is essential for all sectors of the economy: agriculture, industry, transport, and commercial.
It is needed to cook, provide light and heat, and propel vehicles.
Industrial machineries rely entirely on continuous power generation.
Agricultural modernization (e.g., tube wells, tractors) demands high energy.
Overall economic growth plans inherently require increasing amounts of energy consumption.

sub_questions.solution: Energy is an indispensable basic requirement for the economic development of any nation. Every single sector of the national economy—be it agriculture, industry, transport, commercial, or domestic—needs energy inputs to function properly. In agriculture, energy is crucial for operating modern machinery, tube wells, and producing fertilizers. The manufacturing sector relies entirely on continuous power generation to run heavy machineries and process raw materials into finished goods. The transport sector cannot propel vehicles, ships, or aircraft without energy fuels. Furthermore, the domestic sector requires energy for basic survival needs like cooking, heating, and lighting. Consequently, any ambitious plan for sustainable economic development inherently demands a steadily increasing consumption of energy, cementing its status as the foundational pillar of modern progress.

sub_questions.text: ऊर्जा के परम्परागत स्रोत किस प्रकार अपरम्परागत स्रोत से भिन्न हैं ? स्पष्ट कीजिए
sub_questions.text_english: How are conventional sources of energy different from non-conventional sources ? Explain.

key_points: Conventional sources are finite and exhaustible; non-conventional are infinite and renewable.
Conventional sources (like coal, petroleum) cause severe pollution; non-conventional are eco-friendly.
Conventional sources have been used for a long time; non-conventional are relatively recent technologies.
Conventional energy generation is highly centralized; non-conventional can be decentralized.

sub_questions.solution: Conventional and non-conventional sources of energy differ fundamentally across several aspects. Conventional sources, such as coal, petroleum, and natural gas, have been used for a very long time. They are non-renewable, meaning their reserves are finite and exhaustible. Furthermore, burning them causes massive greenhouse gas emissions, leading to severe environmental pollution and global warming. In contrast, non-conventional sources like solar, wind, tidal, and geothermal energy are recently developed technological alternatives. They are renewable and virtually inexhaustible, constantly replenished by nature. More importantly, they are clean and eco-friendly, producing almost zero pollution. While conventional energy plants require huge, centralized infrastructure, many non-conventional sources can be effectively decentralized, making them ideal for long-term sustainable development.

sub_questions.text_english: How are democratic governments better than other forms of government? Explain.

key_points: Promotes equality among citizens.
Enhances the dignity of the individual.
Improves the quality of decision-making through debate.
Provides a structured method to resolve conflicts.
Allows room to correct mistakes.

sub_questions.solution: Democratic governments are vastly superior to other forms of government, such as dictatorships, for several foundational reasons. First, democracy actively promotes equality among all citizens, ensuring everyone has the same political rights regardless of caste, religion, or gender. Second, it fundamentally enhances the dignity of the individual by guaranteeing fundamental rights and freedoms. Third, the democratic process involves extensive deliberation and negotiation, which substantially improves the overall quality of decision-making. Fourth, it provides a peaceful and structured method to resolve societal conflicts, reducing the chances of violence. Finally, democracy provides a unique mechanism to correct its own mistakes, as unpopular leaders or flawed policies can be replaced by the citizens in the next elections.

sub_questions.text_english: How do democracies lead to peaceful and harmonious life among citizens ? Explain.

key_points: Democracy successfully accommodates diverse social divisions.
It provides a peaceful mechanism for resolving conflicts.
Minority rights are protected against majority tyranny.
It develops procedures to negotiate differences through power sharing.
It fosters respect for equal rights and individual dignity.

sub_questions.solution: Democracies play a crucial role in ensuring a peaceful and harmonious life for their citizens by successfully accommodating deep social diversity. No society can fully eliminate conflicts among different groups, but democracy develops institutional procedures to peacefully negotiate these differences. It provides constitutional mechanisms for power sharing, which prevents any single linguistic or religious group from dominating others. Crucially, democracy ensures that the rule of the majority does not become a tyranny over the minority, protecting minority rights. By allowing all groups to voice their grievances legally and expecting the government to address them, democratic systems significantly reduce the likelihood of explosive, violent conflicts, fostering mutual respect and lasting harmony.

sub_questions.text_english: Globalisation is the process of rapid integration or interconnection between countries. Explain the statement with examples.

key_points: MNCs play a major role in integrating markets through foreign investment.
Foreign trade connects distant markets, making goods universally available.
Movement of people between countries for better jobs and education.
Example: Indian IT professionals working globally or foreign car brands sold in India.

sub_questions.solution: Globalisation is precisely defined as the process of rapid integration and deep interconnection between different countries. This process is primarily driven by Multinational Corporations (MNCs) that establish production units and offices worldwide, deeply integrating global supply chains. A prime example is an automobile company like Ford, which designs cars in the US, manufactures components globally, assembles them in India, and sells them worldwide. Furthermore, foreign trade connects distant markets; today, an Indian consumer can easily buy toys manufactured in China or electronics from South Korea. Finally, the movement of human capital—where people travel across borders seeking better education, high-paying jobs, and improved lifestyles—strongly reinforces this global interconnectedness.

sub_questions.text_english: 'Improvement in technology has stimulated the globalisation process.' Explain the statement with examples.

key_points: Advancements in transportation have made global shipping faster and cheaper.
Containerization revolutionized the logistics of goods movement.
Telecommunications (internet, mobile phones) allow instant global communication.
IT sector enables remote services, like BPOs working for foreign clients.

sub_questions.solution: Technological advancement has been the single most critical catalyst in accelerating the globalisation process. Tremendous improvements in transportation technology over the past fifty years have drastically reduced global distances. For instance, the advent of containerization revolutionized shipping, allowing massive volumes of goods to be transported across oceans securely and at significantly lower costs. Secondly, the explosive growth in telecommunications and Information Technology (IT) has completely transformed how businesses operate. The internet, mobile phones, and satellite communications allow individuals and companies to communicate instantly across the globe. A classic example is a London-based magazine whose text is electronically sent to Delhi for designing and printing, perfectly illustrating technology's role in global integration.

बाढ़
बुनियादी सुरक्षा सावधानियाँ लेनी होंगी :
• रेडियो/टेलीविज़न पर नवीनतम मौसम बुलेटिन और बाढ़ चेतावनियों को सुनना। सूचनाओं को दूसरों को संप्रेषित करना।
• परिवार की एक आपातकालीन किट बनाना जिसमें एक वहनीय (पोर्टेबल) रेडियो/ट्रांजिस्टर, बैटरी (टॉर्च), अतिरिक्त बैटरी, आवश्यक औषधियों के साथ फर्स्ट एड बॉक्स, ओ.आर.एस., सूखे मेवा, पीने का पानी, दियासलाई, मोमबत्ती और दूसरे जरूरी सामान हों।
• हरिकेन लैंप, रस्सी, रबड़ ट्यूब, छाता और बांस की छड़ी अपने घर में रखिए, ये लाभदायक होंगी।
• अपनी नकदी, जेवरात, मूल्यवान, महत्त्वपूर्ण कागजात आदि को एक सुरक्षित स्थान पर रखिए।
• यदि बाढ़ आ जाए तो अपने परिवार के सदस्यों और पशुओं के साथ सुरक्षित स्थान जैसे सहायता कैंप, निकासी केन्द्र, ऊँचाई वाले मैदानों में चले जाएं, जहाँ आप आश्रय ले सकें।
• घर छोड़ने से पूर्व बिजली के स्विच और गैस कनेक्शन को बंद कर दें।
बाढ़ के दौरान :
• बाढ़ के पानी में न घुसें; यह खतरनाक हो सकता है।
• बच्चों को बाढ़ के पानी में या उसके समीप न खेलने दें।
• सिवरेज लाइन, नाले-नालियों, पुलिया आदि से दूर रहें।
• सांप आदि से सावधान रहें; सांप का काटना बाढ़ के दौरान सामान्य बात है।
• बिजली के खंभों से दूर रहें और गिरे हुए बिजली के तारों से दूर रहें।
• गीले बिजली के सामानों से दूर रहें; उनका उपयोग करने से पूर्व उनकी जाँच कर लें।
• ताज़ा पका हुआ खाना और सूखे मेवा खाएं। हमेशा अपने खाने का ढक कर रखें।
• गर्म किए हुए और फिल्टर्ड पानी का उपयोग करें।
• अपने घर के समीप सभी नाले-नालियों को साफ रखें।
• रुके हुए पानी से रोग वाहक / जल जनित रोग उत्पन्न हो सकते हैं। बीमारी की अवस्था में मेडिकल सहायता लें।
• ब्लीचिंग पाउडर और नींबू का उपयोग करें और आसपास के इलाके को विसंक्रामक रखें।

Read the following source carefully and answer the questions that follow :
FLOODS
Basic safety Precautions To Be Taken:
• Listen to radio/TV for the latest weather bulletins and flood warnings. Pass on the information to others.
• Make a family emergency kit which should include; a portable radio/transistor, torch, spare batteries, a first aid box along with essential medicines, ORS, dry food items, drinking water, matchboxes, candles and other essential items.
• Keep hurricane lamp, ropes, rubber tubes, umbrella and bamboo stick in your house. These could be useful.
• Keep your cash, jewellery, valuables, important documents etc. in a safe place.
• If there is a flood, move along with your family members and cattle to safe areas like relief camps, evacuation centers, elevated grounds where you can take shelter.
• Turn off power and gas connections before leaving your house.
During floods:
• Don't enter into flood waters; it could be dangerous.
• Don't allow children to play in or near flood waters.
• Stay away from sewerage line, gutters, drains, culverts etc.
• Be careful of snakes; snakebites are common during floods.
• Stay away from electric poles and fallen power-lines to avoid electrocution.
• Don't use wet electrical appliances-get them checked before use.
• Eat freshly cooked and dry food. Always keep your food covered.
• Use boiled and filtered drinking water.
• Keep all drains, gutters near your house clean.
• Stagnation of water can breed vector/water-borne diseases. In case of sickness, seek medical assistance.
• Use bleaching powder and lime to disinfect the surroundings.

Read the following source carefully and answer the questions that follow :
LOCAL GOVERNMENT
This new system of local government is the largest experiment in democracy conducted anywhere in the world. There are now about 36 lakh elected representatives in the panchayats and municipalities etc., all over the country. This number is bigger than the population of many countries in the world. Constitutional status for local government has helped to deepen democracy in our country. It has also increased women's representation and voice in our democracy. At the same time, there are many difficulties. While elections are held regularly and enthusiastically, gram sabhas are not held regularly. Most state governments have not transferred significant powers to the local governments. Nor have they given adequate resources. We are thus still a long way from realising the ideal of self-government.

sub_questions.text: पंचायतों में निर्वाचित प्रतिनिधियों के महत्त्व का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Analyse the significance of the elected representatives in the Panchayats.

key_points: It represents a massive democratic experiment with 36 lakh members.
It empowers local communities by involving massive numbers of grassroots leaders.

sub_questions.solution: The presence of approximately 36 lakh elected representatives in Panchayats makes it the largest democratic experiment globally. It holds massive significance as it decentralizes power, directly involving citizens at the grassroots level in the active decision-making processes of the nation.

sub_questions.text: लोकतंत्र में महिलाओं का प्रतिनिधित्व स्थानीय सरकार की संवैधानिक स्थिति से किस प्रकार प्रभावित हुआ है ?
sub_questions.text_english: In what way has the representation of women in democracy influenced by Constitutional status for local government?

key_points: It has increased women's representation and strengthened their voice in democracy.

sub_questions.solution: The constitutional status granted to local governments has significantly enhanced women's political participation by legally increasing their representation and strongly amplifying their voice within the broader democratic structure of the country.

sub_questions.text: स्थानीय सरकार को संवैधानिक दर्जा देने का देश के लोकतांत्रिक परिदृश्य पर क्या प्रभाव पड़ा है ? किन्हीं दो प्रभावों का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: What has been the impact of granting Constitutional status to local government on the democratic landscape of the country? Analyse any two impacts.

key_points: It has deepened the roots of democracy in the country.
It has empowered women and grassroots leaders by providing them a legal platform.

sub_questions.solution: Granting constitutional status to local governments has had two profound impacts on the democratic landscape. First, it has successfully deepened the roots of democracy by engaging millions of citizens directly in local governance. Second, it has fundamentally empowered marginalized groups, specifically by mandating increased representation and a stronger voice for women in public affairs.
